decisions.structure: CSharp InferBlockBody creates child bindings and mutable-name sets from the parent. EmitIfExpression restores entry locals independently before each sibling arm; interpolation evaluates the bound NameExpression through ResolveLocal. SLG lexical lookup already tests AST visibility but its later mutable-owner normalization checked symbol parents alone, which omit sibling branch blocks.
decisions.branches: A mutable declaration in a sibling block is invisible. A same-name rebind in a descendant block keeps its visible ancestor owner. Function-owned and entry-owned symbols remain separated. Existing source-order and name-matching conditions are retained.
decisions.logic: Require canonical declaration-scope AST ancestry in addition to existing symbol-owner visibility, matching semanticContext declarationScope/declarationAncestor and nearestVisibleMutableBinding. No expression type default, empty operand suppression, name-specific branch, or runtime warning removal.
decisions.diagnostics: CSharp sources and original case stdout/stderr/exit expectations unchanged. Generated LLVM still must assemble, link and execute; any malformed operand remains a failure.

sequenceLimitation: The first private six-case experiment was prepared before this explicit CSharp source-comparison record was captured. This record does not claim that earlier edit or execution order was compliant. It is fixed before combined regression and canonical code integration.
